status: Experimental prediction-cap fix verified in four alternating180-second stationary probe trials; not a production release
scope: Only ARM64 app-private Wave runtime cap50 to cap60. Preserve matching6.2 host/API/bootstrap and ABI dependencies.
limitations: Not a system provider APK or firmware update.
Nested module signing metadata no longer authenticates the modified module.
A runtime module update could replace the patch; check the mapped SHA and live cap.
60ms is a tested experimental bound, not a general refresh-aware policy.
Motion accuracy and visual comfort are not established by stationary testing.
integration: Do not replace the normal Maven cache or normal vendor dependency directory. Use an explicit isolated build overlay; standard dependency preparation may otherwise fetch the original SDK.
rollback: Remove the explicit experimental dependency/asset overlay and rebuild with the original6.2 SDK; clear only the test app module cache.
status_at_creation: experimental SDK candidate; use only with explicit laboratory build configuration
